newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Consorcio Ara started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Consorcio Ara started.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston analyst Rafael Elias-Linero started coverage of Mexican builder Consorcio Ara SA de CV Tuesday with a rating of hold.
-- The rating was "based on our positive outlook for the company, but also on its high relative multiples," he wrote in a report.

--"We believe that the company will continue to benefit from concentrating the bulk of its works in the 'social-interest housing' market while opportunistically participating in the middle-income and residential segments with higher margins."
-- Shares in the company were up 0.70 peso to 28.65 pesos in Mexico City.
